note: v4 splits by avatar look AND by animation clip (docs/project_flow_v4.md, Fair testing). PLACEHOLDER NAMES until Nusrat sends the real looks and clips; the guard refuses a final evaluation while 'placeholder' is true. The split structure (which names are development, which are test) is a proposal for Anisha to confirm.
rules: development looks and clips: used to develop and set every v4 threshold (gesture reader, commander rule, zoom rule).
test looks and clips: never used in development. Scripts refuse them unless --final-evaluation is passed, for the one run with a frozen config.

A run (its set of looks and clips together) must lie wholly in one split: a run that mixes development and test looks, development and test clips, or a development look with a test clip is refused (data_splits_v4.guard_run).
A look or clip that is not listed here is refused (unknown is never assumed to be development); a gesture clip with no logged animation clip name is refused.
While 'placeholder' is true the names are not real: --final-evaluation is refused.

recorded.structure: 2026-10-23, before any v4 run exists (final_evaluation_done false)

styles_note: Look style (e.g. the source of the avatar: VRoid, Asset Store, Mixamo character) for the per-style tables of hri_analysis_v4.py. PLACEHOLDERS until Nusrat sends the real looks; a look without an entry is reported as 'unknown style'.
